items.stem: In a safety management system based on Plan-Do-Check-Act, which activity belongs to the 'Check' stage?

options.text: Measuring and auditing performance against objectives
options.rationale: Correct: checking is the measurement, monitoring and audit stage that evaluates results.

options.text: Setting the health and safety policy and objectives
options.rationale: Setting policy and objectives is part of 'Plan'.

options.text: Implementing control measures and training workers
Revising arrangements after a management review
options.rationale: Acting on review findings is part of 'Act'.

items.explanation: Correct: checking is the measurement, monitoring and audit stage that evaluates results.

items.stem: A proactive health and safety performance indicator is one that:

options.text: Measures activity before a loss occurs, such as completed inspections
options.rationale: Correct: leading/proactive indicators track preventive activity ahead of incidents.

options.text: Counts the number of lost-time injuries last quarter

options.rationale: Compensation totals are reactive outcome measures.

options.text: Records enforcement notices received from a regulator
options.rationale: Enforcement notices follow failures and are reactive.

items.explanation: Correct: leading/proactive indicators track preventive activity ahead of incidents.

items.stem: Select TWO purposes of investigating a workplace incident.

options.text: To identify the underlying causes so recurrence can be prevented
options.rationale: Correct: determining root causes to prevent recurrence is a core purpose of investigation.

options.text: To identify failures in the management system and controls
options.rationale: Correct: investigations reveal management-system and control weaknesses.

options.text: To assign personal blame to an individual worker
options.rationale: Blame-focused investigation undermines learning and is not a legitimate purpose.

options.text: To reduce the amount of recordkeeping required
options.rationale: Investigation typically increases, not reduces, documentation.

options.text: To guarantee no incident can ever happen again
options.rationale: No investigation can guarantee the elimination of all future incidents.

items.explanation: Correct: determining root causes to prevent recurrence is a core purpose of investigation.
